The Sidri-Ashak Rune Stone is one of the three different types of Rune Stones. It bestows the Rune Bow and Helmet spell effect: Bound Bow and Bound Helmet for 120 secs on Self.
Shrouded Armor is an enchanted light armor set, traditionally worn by the assassins of the Dark Brotherhood.
Siege on the Dragon Cult is a quest available in . Captain Valmir wants the Dragonborn to retrieve a "powerful weapon" from Forelhost.

The Silent Moons Enchant is a weapon enchantment that can be learned by disenchanting Lunar Weapons located at the Lunar Forge in the Silent Moons Camp northwest of Whiterun. This enchantment provides a damage bonus at night "while the moons are out," and gives the enchanted weapon a green glow at night and during the day it makes the target of the weapon glow almost yellow. The lunar weapons from which the Silent Moons Enchant can be obtained with three levels of the enchantment, based on player level. Level 1 does 10 points of damage, level 2 does 15 points, and level 3 does 20 points.
Shrouded Gloves are a piece of light armor and part of the Shrouded Armor set found in . The gloves are notably worn by members of the Dark Brotherhood.
The Shrouded Cowl is a piece of light armor and part of the Shrouded Armor set found in . The cowl is notably worn by members of the Dark Brotherhood.
Shrouded Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Shrouded Armor set found in . The boots are notably worn by members of the Dark Brotherhood.
Silver Axe of Paralysis is a one-handed silver weapon. This enchanted axe inflicts paralysis, rendering an adversary unable to move or perform most actions for ten seconds.
Silks of the Sun is an overland set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Stonefalls. Generic pieces are in the Breton Style.
Siege Shield is an Alliance War ability in the Support skill line in . It becomes available at Support Rank 2.

Shroud of the Lich is a dungeon set in . It is a Light Armor set, and can be found in Crypt of Hearts. Generic armor pieces are in the Lich Style, and generic weapon/shield pieces are in the Daedric Style.
Sigil Shop is an in-game digital marketplace in that allows players to purchase arcane items, weapons and armor.
Shulu is an Argonian found inside The Egg and Hammer Inn at Gideon in .

Silver Staff of Peace is a generic staff that is enchanted to inflict paralysis, rendering an adversary unable to move or perform most actions for ten seconds. Despite its name and physical appearance, it is not considered a silver weapon by the game.

Silver Staff of Reckoning is a generic staff that is enchanted to inflict paralysis, and lower an opponent's Speed and Willpower attributes. Despite its name and physical appearance, it is not considered a silver weapon by the game.
Silver Claymore is a weapon in . It is an enchanted version of the Iron Claymore.

The corrupted double remains active only for about 20–30 seconds. The Skull of Corruption can be recharged like any normal staff via soul gems.

Smithing is a skill in . Smithing is referred to as the art of refining raw materials and combining them to create or improve pieces of armor or weapons. It is one of the three crafting skills in Skyrim, falling under the Warrior playstyle, with parallels to alchemy for thieves and enchanting for mages.

The Skyforge Steel Sword is a one-handed weapon found in . It is identical to the Steel Sword in appearance, but has a higher damage rating which is on par with an Elven Sword. Skyforge Steel Swords do as much damage as Elven Swords, but are lighter and require less valuable resources to upgrade, making them a better alternative to Elven weaponry.
The Skyforge Steel Battleaxe is a two-handed weapon found in . It is identical to the Steel Battleaxe in appearance, but has a higher damage rating which is on par with an Elven Battleaxe.

The Skyforge Steel War Axe is a one-handed weapon found in . It is identical to the Steel War Axe in appearance, but has a higher damage rating which is on par with an Elven War Axe, but lighter, meaning less stamina cost for power attacks.

The Skyforge Steel Greatsword is a two-handed weapon found in . It is identical to the steel greatsword in appearance, but has a higher damage rating which is on par with an Elven greatsword.

Snipe is an active skill in the Bow skill line in . It is unlocked at Bow rank 2.
Smuggler's Vest is an upper body medium armor the Vestige receive after completing the quest "Like Moths to a Candle."

He spends most of his time working at The Parchment & Horn, often drinking. The Vestige can buy him a drink as part of This One's On Me achievement.

Spell Breaker is a heavy armor shield which provides 30% spell reflection. This shield is in the pattern of an ancient Dwemer shield and can be obtained through the Shrine of Peryite.

The Speed attribute determines how fast the Hero moves and the length (not height) of jumps. It governs the Acrobatics, Athletics, and Light Armor skills. If it goes over 100, it will still provide the running speed bonus.

Spear is a combat specialization skill in . Use of the skill increases the effectiveness while wielding specific types of weapons. The Spear skill is governed by the endurance attribute. Spears allow the wielder to strike at an opponent from a greater distance than other weapons, which can allow them to avoid attacks from shorter weapons. All weapons that use this skill are two-handed, preventing the use of a shield. The skill level is increased while wielding this weapon during combat. When a strike lands successfully, progress towards the skill increase a percentage. When the progression of the current skill level reaches 100%, the skill level increases by 1.

Spear of the Snow Prince is a unique steel spear found in . It was wielded by the Snow Prince during the Battle of the Moesring and was said to have borne the radiant glow of unknown magicka. It can be found in the ancient burial chamber of Jolgeirr Barrow, during the quest "In Search of the Falmer."
Sovisa Adas is a Dunmer Agent and can be found at Assernerairan and will be hostile. She serves as a medium trainer in Short Blade, Light Armor, and Sneak.

The Staff of Unity and Chaos, frequently shortened to the Staff of Chaos, and also known as the Balac-thurm, was a highly powerful, magical artifact that was fashioned in the early First Era by Loreth. The staff was deemed too powerful and was hidden in the catacombs beneath the city of Mournhold. Jagar Tharn, Imperial Battlemage to Emperor Uriel Septim VII, managed to obtain it by manipulating the Dunmer queen Barenziah, either by disguising himself as a bard known as "Nightingale" or by employing Drayven Indoril to fill the role.
Staff of Sheogorath is an Enchanted Staff in . It belongs to the Daedric Prince of Madness Sheogorath and serves as the symbol of office for the Madgod of the Shivering Isles.

The Staff of Indarys is a leveled staff that can be obtained as a reward from "The Wayward Knight" quest. Upon completion, if Farwil Indarys survives, Count Andel Indarys will give the Hero of Kvatch the chance to decide which weapon to receive; the Staff of Indarys or the Thornblade.
Staff of Worms is a staff in that is owned by Mannimarco, the King of Worms.

The Staff of the Everscamp is a cursed Daedric staff given to the Hero by Rosentia Gallenus as part of the quest "Whom Gods Annoy". The staff is accompanied by four Everscamps, which are weaker, passive versions of normal scamps. If an Everscamp is killed, a new one will appear shortly to take its place. The staff cannot be dropped or sold, and the staff bearer may only get rid of it by "giving it to one who is willing to take it" or returning it to the altar in Darkfathom Cave.
The Staff of Nenalata is a staff with a drain and a dispel effect.
Staff of Magnus is an ancient, powerful staff with mystical ties to the Eye of Magnus and the god who gave it its name in .
